stations.title: Price code
stations.text: Labels and emails each keep a copy of it.

stations.title: Customer
stations.text: One price, on the label and in the email.

captions: Helpers remember now. Next, a customer saw the amber candle at two prices.
The labels keep an old copy of the price code, and that copy drops a zero.
You share the price code from one file and import it everywhere else.
The label, the sale label and the email write the amber price the same way.
One file holds the price code now, and every other file uses it from there.
